retirements.replacement: MCP_WORKSPACE set to a profile folder that holds resources/ (move the <type>/ folders under it), or the folder listed in paths.resources of the profile's config.jsonc

the resources directory that holds its prompts/ folder listed under "paths.resources", an ordered list in which "bundled" names the package's own resources; or no "prompts.directory" at all, which uses the default
the `%judge` modifier or `gates.evaluation.defaultMode` for model-graded gate evaluation

retirements.retired: pass_criteria pattern and length fields (required_patterns, forbidden_patterns, regex_patterns, keyword_count, min_length, max_length)
retirements.replacement: guidance.md for the sentence (a reminder), or a shell_verify or script_tool criterion (a check)
the structured object {overall, rationale, per_gate?, reminders?}

retirements.retired: resource folders at the workspace root
retirements.replacement: each folder moved under resources/ (<workspace>/<type>/ becomes <workspace>/resources/<type>/)

retirements.retired: a config file with no "version" key (the pre-5.0 shape)
retirements.replacement: "version": 5 at the top level of the file
retirements.docPatternReason: the retired spelling is the absence of a key, which no text search can find; its pre-5.0 keys are named only in the refusal's own table

retirements.retired: the top-level `exports` key (a list of keys, `all`, or a `user`/`project` map)
retirements.replacement: a `registrations` map in skills-sync.yaml, keyed by client id, each client set to `all` or to `user` and `project` lists of `prompt:<category>/<id>` keys

retirements.retired: the `mode` field of a tool.yaml `execution` block (`auto`, `manual` or `confirm`)
retirements.replacement: `trigger: explicit` for `mode: manual`, `confirm: true` for `mode: confirm`, and no field for `mode: auto`, which is the default

retirements.retired: a numeric `confidence` in a tool.yaml `execution` block
retirements.replacement: `strict: true` to match only when every required parameter is present, or `strict: false`, the default, to match when any is; `trigger` decides when a tool runs

retirements.retired: the `parameter_match` trigger of a tool.yaml `execution` block
